title: Content editor
summary: The content mode of the SIMAI page editor: a page typed as one flow over a Composition Document (structured-content). Enter and Backspace split and join blocks, Markdown at a line's start and / change a block's kind, the gutter's + and grip (in the margin, outside the text) add, move and open a block's menu, each menu at what opened it, a selection gets the inline bar, Esc chooses blocks, a paste becomes blocks through html@1, a table goes by Tab. A chosen block shows its quick choices over it and gives the rest to the host's panel (or a popover). A picture is dropped, pasted or picked on the page and kept by the host. The element saves nothing: it sends the new Document in change.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

parameters.description: Where a chosen block's parameters beyond its quick choices are edited: popover (an sf-popover from the block's quick toolbar) or host (the host draws them from the params event, as a page editor's Properties panel does).

label.description: The accessible name of the page's blocks.

document.description: The page: a Composition Document of the profile structured-content. Setting a new one starts editing it; the one the editor sent in change is recognised and kept.

kinds.description: The kinds the / menu and the + of the gutter offer, by id (paragraph, heading-2, heading-3, list, ordered-list, quote, alert, details, steps, table, figure, file, code, divider, tabs, card, grid, html). Empty offers the first fourteen.

editor-manifests.description: Composition editor manifests of a host's own types, or ones that replace the Framework's for a type: the parameters form of a block is built from them.

sources.description: Where a picture's or file's stored value is shown from: a map of the value a host answered with to an address the browser loads.

change.const: Every change dispatches change {document, reason} with the whole Document; nothing is stored by the element. select {ids} says which blocks are chosen; leave {} is Esc with blocks chosen; params {id, type, kind, label, fields, open} is the chosen block's parameters for a host's panel; file {file, block, type} hands a picture or a file to the host, which answers with answer-file.

edit.summary: Start typing in a block, the first with no id; refused unknown for a block not in the page.

select.summary: Choose blocks as Esc and Shift+arrows do; refused unknown, not-siblings.

returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown | not-siblings}

insert.summary: Make a block of an offered kind after a block, or at the end of the page; refused unknown.

undo.summary: One step back, as ⌘Z; refused empty with nothing to undo.

redo.summary: One step forward, as ⇧⌘Z; refused empty.

setParameter.summary: Write a block's parameter from a host's panel; empty or the default takes it out; refused unknown or invalid.

schema.description: the value as the field takes it: a choice's or a text's string, a toggle's boolean, an integer; empty takes it out

returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown | invalid}

answerFile.summary: Answer a file event: {block, value, href} stores the picture or file, {block, reason} shows the refusal with a retry, {block, progress} moves the bar; refused unknown.

change.summary: The page changed: {document, reason}. The host saves the document.

sf-content-editor-select.summary: These blocks are chosen: {ids}; empty when none is.

sf-content-editor-leave.summary: Esc with blocks chosen: the person asks to leave the text.

sf-content-editor-params.summary: The chosen block's parameters for a host's panel: {id, type, kind, label, fields, open}; id empty when none is chosen.

sf-content-editor-file.summary: A file to keep: {file, block, type}, type being the block's (content.figure or content.file). The host stores the file and calls answer-file with {block, value, href} or {block, reason}.

untrusted_inputs: the Document's text, drawn as text
pasted HTML, read through the html@1 subset
link addresses, kept only when safe

accessibility.focus: One tab stop, on the field last typed in. Esc chooses the block it is in; the arrows choose others, Enter types again. The / list is announced through aria-activedescendant; changes are said in a status line.

changes: Draws and finds the renamed Framework elements by their new tags (the gutter is sf-button-icon, the block menu sf-menu-context, inline fields are edited through sf-editor-inline (its sf-editor-inline-* events)); the rule relations name cl-<new>. Needs the SIMAI Framework pair with the tag renames (core.runtime 1.21.0). No visible change. Nothing to change for a host on that pair; a host that writes the former tags keeps working until 2027-01-01.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-content-editor wherever a person writes the content of a page (a Composition Document of the profile structured-content).
do_not: Do not store the page in the element; listen for change and save the document it carries
Do not write a parameter equal to its default; the editor already leaves it out
Do not turn an unknown block into a paragraph; the editor keeps it as it is
Do not keep a dropped picture in the Document as a data: URL; store the file from the file event and answer with answer-file
